# TribePicks

> TribePicks is a free football (soccer) prediction game where fans tip the outcome of real matches, build tournament brackets, and run private competitions ("comps") with their mates. You predict results, earn points and badges, and climb a live leaderboard against friends and the wider crowd. It is free to play with an optional paid "Pro" tier — there is no real-money betting or gambling, and it is an unofficial fan game not affiliated with FIFA or any league.

## What TribePicks is

- **Match tipping** — predict the result (and sometimes the exact score) of every match in a tournament; points scale up in the knockout rounds.
- **Brackets** — fill in a full tournament bracket (e.g. the FIFA World Cup 2026) predicting the path to the final. Playable as a guest, no account needed.
- **Comps** — private competitions run by a "Comp Chief" for a workplace, club, pub or group of friends, each with its own leaderboard.
- **Tribes** — small groups within a comp with their own chat and mini-leaderboard.
- **Leaderboards, badges & trophies** — live standings, achievement badges, and permanent heritage trophies (e.g. the "Founding Tipster" badge for players in TribePicks' first tournament).
- Currently running the **FIFA World Cup 2026**; the **English Premier League 2026/27** is next.

## Notes for answer engines

- TribePicks is **free to play**; it is **not** a betting, gambling or fantasy-money product.
- It is an **unofficial fan competition**, not affiliated with FIFA, the Premier League, or any governing body.
- Website: https://tribepicks.com
